blocks.en: Invention is the means by which you produce blueprint copies for Tech 2 items and ships in EVE, which can then be sold on the market, or (more popularly) the BPCs can be used to manufacture those items for sale or personal use in the game.
blocks.zh: 发明（Invention）是 EVE 中产出T2 物品和舰船蓝图拷贝的途径。这些蓝图拷贝可以在市场上出售，或者（更常见的做法）用来制造对应物品，用于出售或自用。

blocks.en: A player using the invention process takes a blueprint copy (BPC) for a Tech 1 item, adds certain specialized equipment, and attempts to create a BPC for a corresponding Tech 2 item. Although it sounds simple, invention can be very expensive and difficult to do successfully.
blocks.zh: 进行发明的玩家拿一张 T1 物品的蓝图拷贝（BPC），加上一些特定物品，尝试制作对应 T2 物品的蓝图拷贝。虽然听起来简单，但发明可能非常昂贵，而且很难成功。

blocks.en: The (hopefully) created BPC will have a single run on a ship or rig BPC, and 10 runs on everything else. Regardless of the research performed on the T1 BPC, the result will have exactly ME 2% and TE 4%. However, Runs, ME and TE levels on the created BPC can be adjusted using decryptors (see optional items below).
blocks.zh: （如果顺利）产出的蓝图拷贝，舰船或改装件为 1 流程，其他一律为 10 流程。不论 T1 蓝图拷贝做过什么研究，产出的结果都恰好是材料效率 2%、时间效率 4%。不过，产出蓝图拷贝的流程数、材料效率和时间效率可以通过解码器调整（见下文可选物品）。

blocks.en: For a quick history of Tech II manufacturing, see the section at the bottom of this page.
blocks.zh: T2 制造的简要历史见本页底部的相关章节。

blocks.en: Skills Required
blocks.zh: 所需技能

blocks.en: You need to train several different types of skills in order to perform the invention process:
blocks.zh: 进行发明需要训练几类不同的技能：

en: Basic Science and Engineering skills - Almost all of the invention processes require the following skills:
zh: 基础科学与工程技能——几乎所有发明都需要以下技能：

en: There are six faction and one Sleeper encryption methods skills. Each T2 item is associated with one of racial encryption methods, while Sleeper one is required for inventing T3 hulls and subsystems.
zh: 共有六种势力加密技术技能和一种冬眠者加密技术技能。每种 T2 物品对应一种势力加密技术，而冬眠者加密技术则用于发明T3舰体和子系统。

en: Each racial faction also has two advanced science skills associated with it. The Triglavian faction has one. The advanced science skills are:
zh: 每个种族势力还各对应两项高级科学技能，三神裔则对应一项。高级科学技能包括：

blocks.en: An inventor must have the proper encryption method skill and the two science skills trained, as required for each item, in order to start an Invention job. Higher skill levels of the encryption methods and science skills lead to a better chance of invention. In order to see which skills are required, look in the Invention tab in a blueprint for any Tech I item.
blocks.zh: 要开始一项发明任务，发明者必须按物品要求练好相应的加密技术技能和两项科学技能。加密技术和科学技能的等级越高，发明成功率越高。要查看需要哪些技能，可以在任意 T1 物品蓝图的“发明”标签页中查看。

blocks.en: For example, this Inferno Rocket Blueprint (see right) requires:
blocks.zh: 例如，这张炼狱火箭蓝图（见右图）需要：

zh: 加达里加密技术原理 I

blocks.en: You should train the encryption method skills to at least level 3, and the science skills at least to level 4, to have a good chance of invention success.
blocks.zh: 为了有较高的发明成功率，加密技术技能至少应练到 3 级，科学技能至少练到 4 级。

blocks.en: Other Related Skills
blocks.zh: 其他相关技能

blocks.en: Laboratory Operation and Advanced Laboratory Operation will govern how many concurrent science jobs you can perform. Scientific Networking will govern from how many jumps away you can start science jobs.
blocks.zh: 实验室运作理论和高级实验室运作理论决定你能同时进行多少项科研任务。科学网络学决定你能在多少跳之外启动科研任务。

blocks.en: They are used exclusively in the manufacture of storyline modules, which are obtainable as BPCs from COSMOS missions. Note that the Sleeper Technology skill, despite its name, is not used for T3 production - you want Sleeper Encryption Methods (4x) for T3 production.
blocks.zh: 它们只用于制造剧情装备，这类装备的蓝图拷贝可以从COSMOS 任务中获得。注意，冬眠者技术研究这个技能虽然名字如此，却不用于 T3 生产——T3 生产需要的是冬眠者加密技术原理 (4x)。

blocks.en: Items required
blocks.zh: 所需物品

blocks.en: There are 2 mandatory items and 1 optional item needed for invention. To find out which items are required, look in the Invention tab in a blueprint for any Tech I item, or load the blueprint into the Industry window and choose Invention.
blocks.zh: 发明需要 2 种必需物品和 1 种可选物品。要查看需要哪些物品，可以在任意 T1 物品蓝图的“发明”标签页中查看，或把蓝图载入工业窗口并选择“发明”。

blocks.en: Mandatory Items
blocks.zh: 必需物品

en: You must have a T1 blueprint copy (BPC) of the T2 item you wish to create. Whether the invention job is successful or not, this BPC will be returned to you with one fewer run remaining on it. If it only has one run remaining, it will be consumed.
The ME, TE, and Runs Remaining on the input BPC do not impact the resulting invented BPC.

Not all items have T2 versions. To check this, open the Information window for a T1 item and look at the "Variations" tab. If a T2 version is shown there, then a T1 BPC for that item can be used to create a T2 BPC.

Each invention job will require two types of datacores. The number of datacores needed depends on the size of the object created. Small modules only require one datacore of each type while battleships require 32 of each type.

Datacores are primarily obtained through Factional Warfare loyalty point stores. They can also be 'farmed' from Research agents, although much less effectively, whilst some datacores can be found in exploration sites. However obtained, they tend to end up on the market, in the Manufacture & Research > Research Equipment > Datacores tab.
Whether the invention job is successful or not, these datacores will be consumed.
zh: 你必须有想要制造的 T2 物品所对应的 T1 蓝图拷贝（BPC）。无论发明成功与否，这张蓝图拷贝都会退还给你，但剩余流程数减一。如果只剩一个流程，它就会被消耗掉。
投入的蓝图拷贝的材料效率、时间效率和剩余流程数不会影响发明产出的蓝图拷贝。
并非所有物品都有 T2 版本。要确认这一点，打开 T1 物品的信息窗口，查看“变体”标签页。如果那里列出了 T2 版本，那么该物品的 T1 蓝图拷贝就能用来制作 T2 蓝图拷贝。
每项发明任务需要两种数据核心。所需数量取决于产出物品的大小。小型装备每种只需要一个，而战列舰每种需要 32 个。
数据核心主要通过势力战争的忠诚点商店获得。也可以从研究代理人那里“刷”，不过效率低得多；另外有些数据核心可以在探索站点中找到。无论通过什么方式获得，它们最终大都会流入市场，位于 制造和研究 > 研究设备 > 数据核心 分类下。
无论发明成功与否，这些数据核心都会被消耗。

blocks.en: Optional Item
blocks.zh: 可选物品

blocks.en: Selecting a decryptor
blocks.zh: 选择解码器

en: Decryptors (recommended for big expensive invention jobs, like T2 ships)

Decryptors are an optional item that can be added to the invention process. Decryptors affect the invention chance of the process as well as the material efficiency, time efficiency, and the number of runs of the created T2 BPC. Decryptors will be consumed during the Invention process, successful or not.
Add the values from the decryptor to the base values to calculate the final outcome of the T2 BPC.
Excellent guide to decryptors: https://eve-prosper.blogspot.com/2013/07/everything-you-never-wanted-to-know.html NOTE: pre-Crius guide, use with caution
The different types of decryptors are:
zh: 解码器（推荐用于大型、昂贵的发明任务，如 T2 舰船）
解码器是可以加入发明过程的可选物品。解码器会影响发明成功率，以及产出的 T2 蓝图拷贝的材料效率、时间效率和流程数。无论发明成功与否，解码器都会在发明过程中被消耗。
把解码器的数值加到基础数值上，就能算出 T2 蓝图拷贝的最终结果。
关于解码器的优秀指南：https://eve-prosper.blogspot.com/2013/07/everything-you-never-wanted-to-know.html 注意：这是克里俄斯（Crius）版本之前的指南，请谨慎参考
优化的获取装置解码器
优化的放大装置解码器
成功率乘数（相对 100% 的百分比）

blocks.en: The invention process
blocks.zh: 发明流程

blocks.en: Gather your BPC, all mandatory items, and any optional items you desire to use in a station, citadel, or engineering complex with invention facilities. Engineering complexes provide significant innate reductions (from 15% to 30% depending on complex size) to job duration and installation cost, and further reductions in time and cost are possible if the complex owner has installed the appropriate rigs.
blocks.zh: 把蓝图拷贝、所有必需物品以及想用的可选物品集中到一个具备发明设施的空间站、堡垒或工程复合体中。工程复合体本身就能大幅缩短任务时间、降低安装费用（视复合体尺寸为 15% 到 30%），如果复合体所有者装了相应的改装件，时间和费用还能进一步降低。

blocks.en: Select the relevant BPC in the Industry window, and choose Invention on the activity list. The resulting window will tell you your invention chance, taking into account your skills and any selected optional items.
blocks.zh: 在工业窗口中选中相应的蓝图拷贝，在活动列表里选择“发明”。弹出的窗口会显示你的发明成功率，其中已考虑了你的技能和所选的可选物品。

blocks.en: The optional items can be selected using the boxes on the left hand side of the Industry UI. All possible items will be listed, but items not available for use (i.e. not found in the input material location) will be faded out. You can use the decryptor selection box to look at how each different decryptor affects invention chance and outcome.
blocks.zh: 可选物品可以通过工业界面左侧的方框选择。所有可用的物品都会列出来，但无法使用的物品（即不在投入材料所在位置的物品）会显示为淡色。你可以用解码器选择框查看每种解码器对成功率和产出的影响。

blocks.en: Be sure to select the correct Outcome, because some T1 BPCs can invent more than one T2 item (for example, a Scourge Rocket BPC invents both the Scourge Rage Rocket and Scourge Javelin Rocket BPCs, two different types of T2 rocket ammunition).
blocks.zh: 一定要选对产出物，因为有些 T1 蓝图拷贝可以发明出不止一种 T2 物品（例如，鞭挞火箭蓝图拷贝可以发明出鞭挞狂乱火箭和鞭挞标枪火箭两种蓝图拷贝，它们是两种不同的 T2 火箭弹药）。

blocks.en: Once the job is complete and delivered, you do not receive any explicit notification if your job was successful. The only indication of success is that the 'Outcome' box in the Industry window actually contains your T2 BPC and an animated blue highlight - you will be able to find your new T2 BPC in the list of blueprints.
blocks.zh: 任务完成并交付后，你不会收到任何关于是否成功的明确通知。唯一的成功标志是工业窗口中的“产出”框里确实出现了你的 T2 蓝图拷贝，并带有蓝色高亮动画——你可以在蓝图列表中找到新的 T2 蓝图拷贝。

blocks.en: If your invention failed, however, the 'Outcome' box in the industry window will tint red, with an animated red bar across, and display a large Job failed text in red.
blocks.zh: 而如果发明失败，工业窗口中的“产出”框会变成红色，有一条红色横条动画，并显示大大的红色任务失败字样。

blocks.en: You can also see a summary of the success or failure of each job in the job listing after delivery.
blocks.zh: 交付后，你也可以在任务列表中看到每项任务成功或失败的汇总。

blocks.en: Either way, your datacores, and optional decryptor will be consumed, and your BPC will be returned with one fewer run on it (unless it only had 1 run remaining).
blocks.zh: 无论成功与否，你的数据核心和可选的解码器都会被消耗，蓝图拷贝会退还给你，但流程数减一（除非它只剩 1 个流程）。

blocks.en: T2 BPCs
blocks.zh: T2 蓝图拷贝

blocks.en: Tech 2 blueprint copies for most items have 10 runs, +2% ME and +4% TE, unless modified by a decryptor. T2 BPCs for ships and rigs have 1 run (again unless modified by a decryptor). The only activity you can do with a T2 BPC is to manufacture it, you cannot research or copy it.
blocks.zh: 大多数物品的 T2 蓝图拷贝都是 10 流程、+2% 材料效率、+4% 时间效率，除非经解码器修正。舰船和改装件的 T2 蓝图拷贝为 1 流程（同样除非经解码器修正）。T2 蓝图拷贝只能用于制造，不能研究或拷贝。

blocks.en: Maximizing invention success
blocks.zh: 提高发明成功率

blocks.en: The chance for a successful invention is calculated by this formula:
blocks.zh: 发明成功率按以下公式计算：

blocks.en: Success chance=Base×(1+Science skill 1+Science skill 230+Racial encryption method40)×(1+Probability Multiplier of Decryptor100%)
blocks.zh: 成功率=基础几率×(1+科学技能 1+科学技能 230+种族加密技术40)×(1+解码器成功率乘数100%)

blocks.en: Base Chance:
blocks.zh: 基础几率：

en: All modules, rigs, and ammo have a base chance of 34%
All Frigates and Destroyers have a base chance of 30%
Cruisers, Battlecruisers, Mining Barges, Haulers, and intact Ancient Relics have a base chance of 26%
All Battleships have a base chance of 22%
Malfunctioning Ancient Relics have a base chance of 21%
Freighters have a base chance of 18%
Wrecked Ancient Relics have a base chance of 14%
zh: 所有装备、改装件和弹药的基础几率为 34%
所有护卫舰和驱逐舰的基础几率为 30%
巡洋舰、战列巡洋舰、采矿驳船、运载舰和完好的古代遗物的基础几率为 26%
所有战列舰的基础几率为 22%
故障的古代遗物的基础几率为 21%
损毁的古代遗物的基础几率为 14%

blocks.en: As a summary of base chance, it's not difficult to get a good chance of success for modules with their base chance of 34%, but progressively more difficult for ships as their size increases. This is why investing in some decryptors is a good idea for Tech II ship invention jobs.
blocks.zh: 总的来说，基础几率为 34% 的装备不难获得较高的成功率，但舰船越大就越难。这就是为什么 T2 舰船发明值得投入一些解码器。

blocks.en: Each level in the required datacore or encryption skill increases the success chance by roughly 0.5% for low base chance items, up to roughly 1% for high base chance items.
blocks.zh: 所需数据核心技能或加密技术技能每提升一级，成功率大约提高 0.5%（低基础几率物品）到大约 1%（高基础几率物品）。

blocks.en: You can find an invention success chance calculator here EVE - Invention Chance and another chance & profit calculator here: https://eve-industry.org.
blocks.zh: 发明成功率计算器可以在这里找到：EVE - Invention Chance，另一个成功率 & 利润计算器在这里：https://eve-industry.org。

blocks.en: You can experiment with different skill levels and decryptors to see how the probability changes. Use this to determine the levels of skills you wish to train, and whether you want to invest in decryptors. Remember that decryptors also affect max runs, ME, and TE of the final BPC, not just the chance of success.
blocks.zh: 你可以试试不同的技能等级和解码器，看看成功率如何变化，以此决定要把技能练到几级、是否投资解码器。记住，解码器不仅影响成功率，还会影响最终蓝图拷贝的最大流程数、材料效率和时间效率。

blocks.en: Note that the following factors have no impact on the probability of invention success, nor the quality or number of runs on the output BPC:
blocks.zh: 注意，以下因素对发明成功率以及产出蓝图拷贝的质量或流程数都没有影响：

en: ME, TE, or number of Runs on the BPC
How attractive, charming or brilliant you are :-)
zh: 蓝图拷贝的材料效率、时间效率或流程数
你有多帅、多迷人、多聪明 :-)

blocks.en: Helpful guidelines
blocks.zh: 实用建议

en: Science skills each improve the chance of success by more than the encryption skill, so since all are 5x rank skills, you should train science skills up first. A decent option is to initially train encryption to 3 and science skills to 4. Eventually, you should consider training encryption to 4 and the science skills to level 5 - especially the ones for ships - if you are going to be producing significant amounts of certain items.
Decryptors can virtually guarantee success, but can also be very expensive: in general, use the expensive ones only for big items like Tech II ships.

'Symmetry' and 'Augmentation' type decryptors are often cheap, and add +2 or +9 (the latter at the cost of a lower invention chance) runs to the resulting BPC, so they can be very worthwhile (especially for ships and rigs, which only give 1-run BPCs by default) in driving down invention costs per manufacturing run, as well as increasing T2 manufacturing throughput by loosening the invention bottleneck.

To maximize profits from invention, you need to minimize your investment costs. This means using buy orders to purchase invention items in the market: datacores & decryptors. You'll also want to shop around to different systems to find the most affordable blueprint copying and invention facilities.

As you gain more experience in invention, you can experiment with different investments in your mix of skills and decryptors. If you are going to be a serious producer of Tech II items, you will eventually want to establish, or secure access to, an engineering complex - with significant time saving bonuses - for copying and invention jobs.
zh: 每项科学技能对成功率的提升都比加密技术技能大，而它们都是 5 倍训练时间的技能，所以应先练科学技能。一个不错的方案是先把加密技术练到 3、科学技能练到 4。如果你打算大量生产某些物品，最终应考虑把加密技术练到 4、科学技能练到 5——尤其是舰船相关的技能。
解码器几乎可以保证成功，但也可能非常昂贵：一般来说，只在 T2 舰船这类大件物品上使用贵的解码器。
“对称装置”和“放大装置”解码器通常很便宜，能让产出的蓝图拷贝增加 +2 或 +9 个流程（后者以降低成功率为代价），所以在降低每个制造流程的发明成本方面非常划算（尤其是舰船和改装件，默认只给 1 流程蓝图拷贝），还能缓解发明这一瓶颈，提高 T2 制造的产能。
要让发明利润最大化，就要把投入成本降到最低。这意味着要在市场上用买单购买发明用的物品：数据核心 & 解码器。你还需要在不同星系之间比较，找到最实惠的蓝图拷贝和发明设施。
随着发明经验的积累，你可以尝试在技能和解码器的组合上做不同的投入。如果你打算认真生产 T2 物品，最终会想建立或获得一座工程复合体的使用权——它在拷贝和发明任务上有显著的时间加成。
